input:
Labeled defect
- root cause: The exception-message predicate requires the regular expression to match the entire exception message.
- failure path: Given an exception message with a matching prefix followed by additional diagnostic text, the retry condition returns false and Tenacity propagates the exception without retrying.

Reviewer finding
- description: The match check changed from re.match (prefix match) to fullmatch (whole-string match), which the commit title does not mention.
- rationale: Trigger: retry_if_exception_message(match="timeout") and an exception whose str is "timeout after 5s". Before this change, match() succeeds and the retry happens. After it, fullmatch() fails, so the exception is not retried. Any existing pattern that relied on a prefix or partial match now silently stops retrying, and callers see the original exception raised with no retries.
critique: The finding identifies the switch to fullmatch, which requires the pattern to match the whole exception message. It also describes the same failure: a message with a matching prefix plus extra text ("timeout after 5s") makes the predicate return false, so the exception propagates without retry. That is the same operation and failure path as the labeled defect.
